# beware.dog

> beware.dog is a monthly fraud watch service for small businesses (5 to 50
> people) that move money by email: title and escrow companies, bookkeeping
> and accounting firms, agencies, clinics, property managers, law firms.
> It watches for lookalike domains registered against the business, drills
> the staff who can approve wires and invoices against fake emails and
> cloned-voice phone calls, and reports what it found in one page a month.

beware.dog is built for businesses too small to have a security team. There
is no IT manager here; the buyer is the owner or operator. The product is
run by one named founder, not a support ticket queue.

## The offer

The Watch: $149/month, founding rate locked for life (standard rate $299/mo
once founding spots fill). Founding spots capped at 25 because each account
is watched personally. Cancel anytime, no contract. The first lookalike
domain scan is run and shown before any money changes hands. If the first
monthly report does not land within 7 days of signup, that month is free.

What's included, every month:
- Weekly lookalike-domain scan of the business's domain, with alerts within
  one business day when a new fake registration appears
- One phishing-email drill and one phone/voice-clone drill against the
  people who can actually move money, with a debrief of who verified and
  what to change
- A one-page monthly report in plain English, no dashboard to log into

What it explicitly does not do: read, filter, or sit inside your email;
monitor or listen to phone lines; touch files, servers, or backups; or stop
ransomware (that's an MSP's job, and beware.dog will say so).
